title: If only the picture shown was honest
text: If only the picture shown was honest. I usually try to read descriptions prior to purchase. It cuts down on the disappointment. In this case however the descriptors were misleading. This is NOT a good Ottoman. Not even a good pouf. It doesn't hold its shape well at all. My cat uses it now as her imprint is permanently imprinted on it. Oh well. You get what you pay for.
